context: 5. Calculate percentage increase in enrolment from last year and create an enrolment report.'
field_description: Extract the total enrolment (student) count for LAST YEAR (2024) from the enrolment report. Look for labels such as total enrolment number from last year, Last Year Enrolment, Previous Year, or a value near 2024. Return only the student count, typically between 5 and 10000 - do not return the year itself, and do not return a percentage.

context: 5. Calculate percentage increase in enrolment from last year and create an enrolment report.'
field_description: Extract the total enrolment (student) count for CURRENT YEAR (2025) from the enrolment report. Look for labels such as total enrolment number from current year, Current Year Enrolment, This Year, or a value near 2025. Return only the student count, typically between 5 and 10000 - do not return the year itself, and do not return a percentage.

context: 5. Calculate percentage increase in enrolment from last year and create an enrolment report.'
field_description: Extract the percentage increase or decrease in enrolment. Look for labels such as percent increase, percentage increase, or growth percent, usually shown with a percent sign. Can be negative for a decrease. Do not reuse the same value as Enrollment_2024 or Enrollment_2025.
